Raw material for the stock_1101 recipe: verbatim monthly rwd/zh/afterTrading/STOCK_DAY JSON for 1101.TW (Taiwan Cement), fetched 2026-11-18 by scripts/acquire_1101.py from TWSE open data (https://www.twse.com.tw). Government open data - redistribution permitted with source attribution.

quarterly/: t187ap06_L_ci_115Q3.json + t187ap07_L_ci_115Q3.json = official TWSE/MOPS open-data snapshots (openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/opendata, income statement + balance sheet, YTD in TWD thousands, fetched 2026-11-18; provenance and cross-validation anchors - not recipe inputs). yf_1101_quarterly_*.csv = Yahoo Finance backfill via yfinance (per-quarter TWD, 2025Q3..2026Q3; declared third-party source, recipe inputs whose overlap quarter matches the official snapshot exactly on revenue and total assets).
